# DAX INFO functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **INFO functions**: 0 implemented, 0 partial and 72 not implemented, out of 72.

The INFO functions query the metadata of Power BI's Analysis Services engine. Lumen has no such engine and implements none of them. To inspect a model, use Model view and the Properties pane.
